questions.q: What can a user with a Free Power BI license NOT do?
options: Share dashboards or publish content to other people's workspaces
Connect to any data at all
Build a report for personal use
Sign into the Power BI service
questions.explain: Free users can connect to data and build reports/dashboards for themselves, but can't share, collaborate, or publish to other people's workspaces — that requires Pro, PPU, or a capacity workspace.

questions.q: What does a Premium Per User (PPU) license add on top of Pro?
options: Most Premium capacity features — but sharing that content is limited to other PPU users
Unlimited free licenses for the whole organization
The ability to install Power BI Desktop on more machines
Nothing — PPU and Pro are functionally identical
questions.explain: PPU includes Pro's capabilities plus most Premium features, but content shared from a PPU workspace can generally only be viewed by other PPU-licensed users, unless it's also in a Premium/Fabric capacity.

questions.q: How can a Free-license user view a report a Pro user shares with them?
options: The report and its semantic model must both be stored in a workspace assigned to a Premium or Fabric capacity
It's never possible under any circumstances
The Free user must temporarily upgrade to Pro for exactly one day
Only if the report has fewer than 10 visuals
questions.explain: A capacity (Premium P SKU or Fabric F64+) is what allows a Pro or PPU user's content to be viewed by Free-license colleagues — the license alone doesn't determine this; where the content is stored does too.

questions.q: What is Microsoft Fabric, in relation to Power BI?
options: An umbrella platform that houses Power BI alongside data engineering, data science, and real-time analytics, sharing the same underlying capacity
A completely separate product with no connection to Power BI
A discontinued predecessor to Power BI
A mobile-only version of Power BI
questions.explain: Fabric integrates Power BI's licensing and administration with a broader set of data tools. A Fabric F64+ capacity does everything a Power BI Premium capacity did, plus unlocks Fabric's other workloads.

questions.q: Two colleagues both hold Pro licenses. Can they share Power BI content with each other without a capacity?
options: Yes — Pro users can share dashboards and collaborate with other Pro users without needing a Premium or Fabric capacity
No — a capacity is always required for any sharing, regardless of license
Only if they are in the exact same physical office
Only if the content was created in the last 24 hours
questions.explain: Pro-to-Pro sharing works without a capacity. Capacities become necessary specifically when sharing needs to reach a Free-license user, or when Premium-only features are involved.
